claim: Money-transmission boundary, stated precisely: control of customer funds is the trigger for state money-transmitter licensing; Stripe (Stripe Payments Company) holds MTLs/MSB registration across US states (California MTL since 2016) and its Treasury product holds funds at partner banks — a platform built on Stripe Connect where charges settle to the club's own connected account never takes custody and avoids MTL obligations; any future custody feature (wallets, held team balances) crosses the line and requires the licensed-partner structure (Stripe Treasury/BaaS).
page_title: What is a money transmitter? | Stripe
quote: control of funds is the trigger for money transmitter licensing... Stripe holds money licenses around the world, including Money Transmitter Licenses (MTL) and registered Money Services Business (MSB) status in the US... Treasury for platforms in the US is provided by Stripe Payments Company, a licensed money transmitter, with funds held at Stripe's bank partners
